_comment: One project = one config. Copy to story_configs/<slug>.json and fill in. Generator reads slug/project_name/idea/choices; publisher reads the rest. Delete _comment lines.
_idea: One rich paragraph distilled from the requirements doc or the described idea. Say what it is, who uses it, what the AI does, and that a human stays in control. Assume Claude Code / real code (React, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker), never no-code tools.
idea: A multi-tenant, multi-user platform that ... Autonomous agents ... while a human approves anything that goes out. Strict per-tenant isolation; role-based access ...
_choices: Array of '- Label: description' lines the pipeline treats as design constraints. Always include Control, Intelligence, Domain, Primary users, Data, Trust/compliance, Stack.
choices: - Control: AI drafts, a human reviews and approves before anything publishes or spends
- Intelligence: retrieval-augmented generation plus ML over the domain data
- Primary users: <roles>, with strict per-tenant isolation and role-based access
- Data: PostgreSQL system of record; external providers via APIs (mocked for the demo); append-only audit log
- Trust and compliance: append-only audit, approval gates on outbound actions, GDPR/CCPA, role-based access
- Stack: React frontend, Node/Express backend, PostgreSQL, Docker; REST API with OpenAPI docs; deployed to a public demo URL
_target: Where the list lands. mode 'existing' uses a known project's bucket/todoset/vault; mode 'create' makes a new project and grants grant_ids. Internship project = 24865175 / todoset 4327600402 / vault 4327600403. Gov Contracts = 47346103 / todoset 9908475794 / vault 9908475797.
_builder_id: The intern/operator who owns EVERY build task. e.g. Anvi 52639032, Meghana 52489233, Omolola/others.
_approver: Who signs off, and how. approver_mode 'per-release' = one gate per release (heavy involvement, e.g. Ram 17346350). 'phase-gates' = 4 consolidated gates (light-touch exec, e.g. Ali 17454835).
_marketing_co_assignee_id: Optional. If set, this person is co-assigned on marketing/social/prompt/content tasks (e.g. Sohail 47335940). Omit or null for non-marketing builds.
